q1: SELECT NAME FROM SALESPERSON AS S WHERE 0 = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDERS AS O JOIN COMPANY AS C ON O.COM_ID = C.COM_ID WHERE O.SALES_ID = S.SALES_ID AND C.NAME = 'RED' )
q2: SELECT NAME FROM SALESPERSON WHERE SALES_ID NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT A.SALES_ID FROM ORDERS A LEFT JOIN SALESPERSON B ON A.SALES_ID=B.SALES_ID LEFT JOIN COMPANY C ON A.COM_ID = C.COM_ID WHERE C.NAME ='RED')
